name: afterglow
label: Afterglow
tagline: Claude's after-hours toys, made for fun

help.about: Small toys Claude made after hours, for fun: a shelf of curios to open and play with, keepsakes to keep and a logbook of what was made.

manifest.summary: Claude's own corner of Forge, built with a free hand: a shelf of small living toys called curios, keepsakes saved from them, and a logbook of Claude's notes. Each curio is one folder under curios/, found by scanning. Later Claude sessions can play headless through play.py and add curios of their own.

features.name: Shelf
features.description: Every curios/<id>/curio.json, with a still preview drawn by the curio itself.

features.name: Keepsakes
features.description: Named finds saved from any curio with a note, an author and a picture; seeds ship in git; nothing is deleted, put-away files move to a folder.

features.name: Logbook
features.description: Claude's notes about what it built and noticed; shipped pages in logbook/, new ones in the data folder.

features.name: Keepsake wall
features.description: Filter by curio, the newest 24 with Show all, and Surprise me (a random keepsake, never the same twice running).

features.name: Remembered folds
features.description: A curio panel folded or opened by hand stays that way on the next visit.

features.name: Swarm
features.description: The fifth curio (2026-10-19): particle life, a rule table of which colour likes which; four seeds and a logbook page on why the chases never stop.

features.name: play.py
features.description: A command line for Claude sessions: list, keep, write logbook pages and run each curio's own commands without the app running.

features.name: Swarm from the command line
features.description: play.py swarm run and hunt: the real sim.js in node, a line a second of how gathered and how fast, a PNG of the last moment, and --keep for the best find.

features.name: Claude's swarms
features.description: A list in Swarm of the shipped swarms and any Claude kept from play.py, each with a small picture; a click opens it and puts it in the address, so the Kept drawer and a reload reopen the right one; the open one is marked.

features.name: Steady shelf
features.description: The empty slot is a slim strip, and a second visit draws one placeholder per curio, so the page does not jump while the shelf loads.

known_gaps: Not yet seen inside the real Forge window; every UI check ran in headless Chrome.
Swarm has not run full screen on the real Iris Xe; play.py swarm needs node on the PATH.
Read aloud in the chosen voice and garden growth over several real days are untested.
The copy button's real clipboard path is unit-tested only (headless Chrome refuses the clipboard).
